dynamic_decor_signs.behavior: LevelData.decor maps map glyphs to neon_sign/neon_sign_h/billboard; NeonSign uses sign_texts, falling back to OPEN if empty; HoloBillboard uses billboard_ads. ScenerySupport also uses sign_texts for decor bounds.
dynamic_decor_signs.chapter1_fields: All nine Chapter 1 LevelData omit explicit decor/sign_texts/billboard_ads; omitted decor uses the LevelData empty-dictionary default; the class also defines default sign_texts and billboard_ads. These arrays alone do not prove a sign is instantiated: decor glyphs must be mapped and present.
